newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA seen ready for large Feb IPE gas oil delivery.
newsitem.headline: ARA seen ready for large Feb IPE gas oil delivery.

text.p: Traders in the ARA region say the gas oil barge market is bracing itself for a large delivery against the February IPE futures contract which expires on Wednesday.
A number of barge traders said they understood that oil storage in Rotterdam and Amsterdam had already been booked in readiness for up to 600,000 tonnes of gas oil.
"I understand space has being booked up in advance," one trader said.
No storage firms were willing to comment.
Physical and futures traders say a U.S. trading house which engineered a wide spread between February and March IPE contracts, will be the dominant recipient. Traders cite three potential deliverers.
Such a delivery volume would be among the highest on record, although well below the largest ever delivery, of 865,100 tonnes
